If you are preparing a fermented pickle, this step isn't needed but if you are making a vinegar pickle you should do the following:

  • Slice your desired pickle however you like. For cucumbers, try spears.

  • Put in a container, I recommend using glass.

  • Use seasalt, etc, and generously apply to your vegetable. Mix well. I usually use around 1/8 cup per pound of veggies.

  • Let it sit. The salt will draw the water out. Some veggies release their water faster than others. For a cucumber pickle an hour is usually enough.

  • Rinse veggies with cold water and let drain. Note: Some veggies benefit from being blanched before pickling. Blanche for 1-2 minutes. Dump into cold water or ice bath then once cool, drain it or squeeze out excess water.

  • Put in container of choice.

  • Heat your picking liquid of choice even if it's a second wind pickle.

  • Pour hot liquid on veggies and close container. Depending on what it is, it could be go to go in a few hours. Cucumbers need about 2 weeks honestly.
